title: Submit the native-mail read-only existence-probe proposal
problem: PR #1475 merged a validated proposal Ask for a read-only native-mail existence probe. The cloud session that drafted it had no configured workspace, so the proposal is not yet registered. All three native-mail hook adapter Actions need this probe.
desired_effect: Register the exact reviewed proposal against the configured live workspace with `arcadia agent-ask preview --file`, and keep the receipt.

does: Refuse unless Arcadia's own resolver returns a configured, non-experiment workspace
Run `arcadia agent-ask preview --file` once (120 s bound), which records a capture and proposal receipt in that workspace
Keep stdout, stderr and the receipt in a timestamped runs/ directory
never_does: Settle, accept or reject the proposal, or create or change any Action, Plan, Decision, pointer or queue
Commit, push or edit any repository file; pass a guessed workspace path; touch an experiment workspace
Make a model call, install software or use a credential

success.effect: The proposal is registered in the live workspace and the receipt (proposal and capture ids) is printed. Registration is not approval.
success.next: The proposal waits for normal triage. Its settlement, and any amendment to the build-*-native-mail-hook Actions, are separate gates.

failure.effect: Nothing is registered when the file is missing or changed, the workspace does not resolve, or preview refuses or times out. All output is kept.
failure.next: Read the named run.log. A missing file usually means it was already settled and archived. A changed hash needs a fresh review. A workspace or preview refusal needs the host fixed and this button pressed again.
